fields.Name: T80 - Forums Category Threads
fields.Description: Verifies a Forum Category's related Forum Threads can be reached from the full record form and that thread rows render.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Forum Categories' entity from the entity tree. Select the category 'Cheesemaking Techniques' (or any category) and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full form. On that form, locate the related Forum Threads section/tab and view it, confirming thread rows are displayed. Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Forum Category full record form is open showing category detail fields
The related Forum Threads section/tab is visible with thread rows (or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
